title: Bounded-distortion L1 embeddings of planar and bounded-treewidth graphs

result.label: Bounded-distortion L1 embeddings of planar and bounded-treewidth graphs
result.statement: Resolves the planar and bounded-treewidth cases of the Gupta–Newman–Rabinovich–Sinclair conjecture. Shortest-path metrics of finite connected graphs with arbitrary positive edge lengths embed into real L 1 with universal distortion for planar graphs, and distortion depending only on treewidth for bounded-treewidth graphs. The corresponding multicommodity flow–cut gaps are uniformly bounded.
